At Present Confined Distt Jail Tonk.
 ----Petitioner  Versus The State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sandeep Jain
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Suresh Kumar, PP

Mr. SS Hasan, Sr. Adv. with Mr. S.
 Kashif for Complainat
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRAVEER BHATNAGAR ( V. J. ) Order 16/06/2023 1.
The instant bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of accused-petitioner Doctor Juber Khan.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.
247/2022 dated 10.09.2022 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Tonk for the offence(s) under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 354 & 377 IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Tonk
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the accused-petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the case.
The petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Thus the bail application of the petitioner may be allowed.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposes the bail application.

4. Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, this court deems it just and proper to enlarge the accused-petitioner on Doctor Juber Khan S/O Mohd. 5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Doctor Juber Khan S/o Mohd. Usman Khan shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No. 247/2022 dated 10.09.2022 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Tonk provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
